judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant blue-hour city view, but the sky is mostly empty and the clouds are too incidental to make it a strong cloud photograph.
strengths: low cloud band adds atmosphere over the mountains
good depth from foreground rooftops to distant skyline
weaknesses: sky is mostly a plain gradient
clouds are a minor part of the scene
